input.description: url is required: the link of the community post. results_limit defaults to 100 and accepts 1 to 1000.

endpoints.name: YouTube Related Videos
endpoints.description: List the videos YouTube recommends next to a video URL, with titles, channels, view counts, and thumbnails for each recommendation.

url.description: YouTube video or Shorts URL, such as https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ

input.description: url is required. Returns the videos YouTube recommends next to that video, usually about 20.

endpoints.name: YouTube Channel Search
endpoints.description: Search YouTube channels by keyword and get channel IDs, names, subscriber counts, avatars, and the description snippet shown in results.

input.description: query is required. Returns channels in YouTube's search order. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 200.

endpoints.name: YouTube Shorts Search
endpoints.description: Search YouTube Shorts by keyword and get each Short's link, caption, view count, and vertical thumbnail in YouTube's search order.

input.description: query is required. Returns Shorts in YouTube's search order. results_limit defaults to 25 and accepts 1 to 200.

endpoints.name: YouTube Search Suggestions
endpoints.description: Get the autocomplete suggestions YouTube's search box offers for a partial query, ranked, for the language and region you choose.

language.description: Language code for the suggestions, such as en, es or pt-BR.

query.description: The partial search text to complete.

region.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, such as US or GB.

input.description: query is required. language defaults to en and region to US.

endpoints.name: YouTube Email Finder
endpoints.description: Find the public business emails behind a YouTube channel URL, with the pages each address was found on; billed only when an email is found.

url.description: YouTube channel URL in the @handle or /channel/UC... form.

input.description: url is required: a channel link in the @handle or /channel/UC... form. Returns the public contact emails found for the channel; credits are charged only when at least one email is found.
